recommendations.recommendation: Simplify your life and reduce your affairs to a few essentials.
recommendations.rationale: Life is frittered away by detail; a simpler life frees time and attention for what matters.
recommendations.scope: those who feel their lives are cluttered

recommendations.recommendation: Live deliberately, confronting only the essential facts of life.
recommendations.rationale: He went to the woods so that at death he would not discover he had not lived.

recommendations.recommendation: Question the conventional life of toil and accumulation that leads to quiet desperation.
recommendations.rationale: Most men are so occupied with needless cares and coarse labor that they cannot gather life's finer fruits.
recommendations.argued_against: farmers burdened by inherited property, and laborers enslaved by debt

recommendations.recommendation: Reduce your needs to the true necessities of food, shelter, clothing, and fuel.
recommendations.rationale: Most luxuries and comforts hinder rather than elevate; his own accounts show how little is needed.

recommendations.recommendation: Beware of enterprises that require new clothes.
recommendations.rationale: What matters is a new wearer, not new clothes; fashion is slavish imitation.

recommendations.recommendation: Work only as much as needed to support a simple life.
recommendations.rationale: By working about 6 weeks a year he met all his expenses and kept the rest of his time free.
recommendations.conditions: he does not insist everyone should live exactly as he did

recommendations.recommendation: Do not adopt my way of life; find and pursue your own.
recommendations.rationale: He wants as many different persons in the world as possible, each following his own way rather than his father's, mother's, or neighbor's.

recommendations.recommendation: Read the great classics, ideally in their original languages, as serious exercise.
recommendations.rationale: Heroic books require the reader's best effort and are the noblest recorded thoughts of humanity.
recommendations.argued_against: easy reading and village gossip literature

recommendations.recommendation: Value solitude.
recommendations.rationale: He never found a companion so companionable; society is commonly too cheap and frequent.

recommendations.recommendation: Live close to nature and attend to its rhythms and wildness.
recommendations.rationale: Nature refreshes and teaches; we need the tonic of wildness and the sight of inexhaustible vigor.

recommendations.recommendation: Rise early and make each morning a new awakening.
recommendations.rationale: Morning is when we are most awake; to be awake is to be alive.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not live in hurry and waste; let time be a stream you fish in.
recommendations.rationale: People rush and starve before they are hungry; most busyness accomplishes little.

recommendations.recommendation: Ignore most news, mail, and gossip.
recommendations.rationale: Reading of one robbery or fire is enough to know the principle; new technologies speed messages with nothing to say.

recommendations.recommendation: Seek purity and restraint of the appetites, leaning toward simple food and away from stimulants.
recommendations.rationale: The higher nature is awakened by chastity and temperance; he believes humans will gradually leave off eating animals.
recommendations.conditions: he admits he is not wholly consistent himself

recommendations.recommendation: Outgrow hunting and fishing as you mature.
recommendations.rationale: Hunting introduces boys to the woods, but those with higher aims eventually leave the gun and rod behind.
recommendations.conditions: hunting is acceptable as an early stage

recommendations.recommendation: Be cautious about philanthropy that neglects one's own integrity.
recommendations.rationale: Doing good is often a cover for self-satisfaction; it is better to be good than to do good, and he would flee from a do-gooder.

recommendations.recommendation: Explore your inner life rather than traveling far for novelty.
recommendations.rationale: There are whole unexplored continents within each person, worthier of discovery than distant lands.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep step to the music you hear, even if it differs from others' rhythm.
recommendations.rationale: Someone out of step with companions may simply hear a different drummer.

recommendations.recommendation: Advance confidently toward your dreams and put foundations under your castles in the air.
recommendations.rationale: His experiment taught that whoever does so meets with unexpected success.

recommendations.recommendation: Love your life, however poor it is.
recommendations.rationale: Even poverty offers pleasant hours; the faultfinder will find fault even in paradise.

recommendations.recommendation: Value truth above love, money, and fame.
recommendations.rationale: Truth is what endures; lavish tables without sincerity leave one cold.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not assume elders' advice is valuable; test life for yourself.
recommendations.rationale: In 30 years he had never heard a word of valuable advice from his seniors; age is no better teacher than youth.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid debt and inheritances of farms and property that enslave you.
recommendations.rationale: Inherited farms and mortgages make men serfs pushing their property before them all their lives.

recommendations.recommendation: Recognize that people have become tools of their tools.
recommendations.rationale: Improvements are often improved means to unimproved ends, and the division of labor removes the joy of building one's own house.
